answer: I would tie each agent to one mobile number on a postpaid plan. First, the agent links its public key to the number, and the carrier confirms the plan is under a verified ID. Second, the network texts a one-time code to that number, checks it is at least 12 months old, with a 5-line cap per person. Third, a second agent on the same number is refused, and a cancelled plan freezes the seat until a fresh check. A line costs $40 a month, so 1,000 fakes burn $40,000 a month, $480,000 a year. A plume of smoke marks one chimney, a cedar stands on one ridge, and a canyon holds one river.
